title: GameLogger Compact Record Schema v3 (unique_id first)
description: Fixed schema for converted GameLogger.gd events. The first output attribute is unique_id, composed from session_id and event_id for the current logger convention.

prefixItems.title: id
prefixItems.description: Coin instance/entity ID, when provided.

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Coin's world X coordinate.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Coin's world Y coordinate.

prefixItems.title: distance
prefixItems.description: Distance from the player to this coin.

prefixItems.title: relative_x
prefixItems.description: Coin X minus player X; positive means coin is to the right.

prefixItems.title: relative_y
prefixItems.description: Coin Y minus player Y; interpret with the game's coordinate convention.

EnemyRow.title: Enemy row
EnemyRow.description: [id, name, x, y, velocity_x, distance, relative_x, relative_y, player_is_above, is_stompable, is_threat]

prefixItems.title: id
prefixItems.description: Enemy instance/entity ID, when provided.

prefixItems.title: name
prefixItems.description: Enemy node/name.

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Enemy's world X coordinate.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Enemy's world Y coordinate.

prefixItems.title: velocity_x
prefixItems.description: Enemy's horizontal velocity.

prefixItems.title: distance
prefixItems.description: Distance from player to enemy.

prefixItems.title: relative_x
prefixItems.description: Enemy X minus player X; positive means enemy is to the right.

prefixItems.title: relative_y
prefixItems.description: Enemy Y minus player Y.

prefixItems.title: player_is_above
prefixItems.description: 1 if logger's above-player test is true, 0 if false, null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: is_stompable
prefixItems.description: 1 if logger flags enemy stompable, 0 if not, null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: is_threat
prefixItems.description: 1 if logger flags enemy as a threat, 0 if not, null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: action
prefixItems.description: Action name, e.g. jump_pressed.

prefixItems.title: physics_frame
prefixItems.description: Physics frame when action occurred.

prefixItems.title: timestamp_unix_ms
prefixItems.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when action occurred.

unique_id.title: unique_id
unique_id.description: Unique event identifier. For current GameLogger records, this is the session_id and event_id joined with a colon (session_id:event_id). If either source field is missing, the converter uses legacy-line:<source line number>.

schema_version.title: schema_version
schema_version.description: Version of the source logger schema.

session_id.title: session_id
session_id.description: Session identifier; combine with event_id for event identity.

event_id.title: event_id
event_id.description: Sequential event ID assigned during the session, restarting for a new session.

event_name.title: event_name
event_name.description: Event name such as session_start, state_snapshot, or coin_picked.

category.title: category
category.description: Event category such as input, collectible, state_snapshot, or anomaly.

timestamp_unix_ms.title: timestamp_unix_ms
timestamp_unix_ms.description: Canonical event timestamp in milliseconds; null only if absent from source.

elapsed_ms.title: elapsed_ms
elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds since current session started at event creation.

physics_frame.title: physics_frame
physics_frame.description: Physics frame of the overall event.

frame.title: frame
frame.description: Process-frame counter in state data, when available.

state_physics_frame.title: state_physics_frame
state_physics_frame.description: Nested snapshot physics frame, separate from the event-level frame.

state_timestamp_unix_ms.title: state_timestamp_unix_ms
state_timestamp_unix_ms.description: Nested snapshot timestamp normalized to milliseconds, when available.

session_time.title: session_time
session_time.description: Elapsed session time in seconds from the state snapshot.

fps.title: fps
fps.description: FPS value from the state snapshot.

scene.title: scene
scene.description: Scene path/name on the event envelope.

state_scene.title: state_scene
state_scene.description: Scene name recorded inside the state snapshot.

game_state.title: game_state
game_state.description: State string such as playing, paused, player_died, victory, or main_menu.

paused.title: paused
paused.description: Pause state from the event envelope's game_state object.

prefixItems.title: score
prefixItems.description: Current game score.

prefixItems.title: deaths
prefixItems.description: Death count recorded by the game.

player_instance_id.title: player_instance_id
player_instance_id.description: Godot instance ID of the player, when provided by event-level player context.

player.title: Player array
player.description: 16 values: [alive, x, y, velocity_x, velocity_y, on_floor, on_wall, on_ceiling, facing, stomp_impulse, speed_max_x, speed_max_y, hitbox_width, hitbox_height, distance_to_ground, distance_to_wall_ahead].

prefixItems.title: alive
prefixItems.description: 1 if player data indicates player alive/present; 0 if false; null if unknown.

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Player world X coordinate.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Player world Y coordinate.

prefixItems.title: velocity_x
prefixItems.description: Player horizontal velocity.

prefixItems.title: velocity_y
prefixItems.description: Player vertical velocity.

prefixItems.title: on_floor
prefixItems.description: 1 if player is on floor; 0 if not; null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: on_wall
prefixItems.description: 1 if player touches a wall; 0 if not; null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: on_ceiling
prefixItems.description: 1 if player touches ceiling; 0 if not; null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: facing
prefixItems.description: Facing direction; typically 1=right and -1=left.

prefixItems.title: stomp_impulse
prefixItems.description: Configured stomp/bounce impulse.

prefixItems.title: speed_max_x
prefixItems.description: Configured maximum horizontal speed.

prefixItems.title: speed_max_y
prefixItems.description: Configured maximum vertical speed.

prefixItems.title: hitbox_width
prefixItems.description: Player hitbox width in game units.

prefixItems.title: hitbox_height
prefixItems.description: Player hitbox height in game units.

prefixItems.title: distance_to_ground
prefixItems.description: Raycast distance to ground; -1 may indicate no hit.

prefixItems.title: distance_to_wall_ahead
prefixItems.description: Raycast distance to wall ahead; -1 may indicate no hit.

inputs.title: Input array
inputs.description: [move_left, move_right, jump, jump_just_pressed, pause, raw_direction_x, raw_direction_y]

prefixItems.title: move_left
prefixItems.description: 1 if left input is pressed; 0 if not; null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: move_right
prefixItems.description: 1 if right input is pressed; 0 if not; null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: jump
prefixItems.description: 1 if jump is held; 0 if not; null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: jump_just_pressed
prefixItems.description: 1 if jump was newly pressed this frame.

prefixItems.title: pause
prefixItems.description: 1 if pause input is pressed; 0 if not; null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: raw_direction_x
prefixItems.description: Right input strength minus left input strength.

prefixItems.title: raw_direction_y
prefixItems.description: Vertical input component supplied by the source logger.

prefixItems.title: coins_collected
prefixItems.description: Number of coins collected according to the snapshot.

prefixItems.title: coins_remaining
prefixItems.description: Number of coin entities reported remaining.

prefixItems.title: nearest_coin
prefixItems.description: Nearest coin row, or null if no nearest coin is available.

prefixItems.title: all_coins
prefixItems.description: List of coin rows.

prefixItems.title: count
prefixItems.description: Number of enemy entities reported in the snapshot.

prefixItems.title: closest_enemy
prefixItems.description: Nearest enemy row, or null if absent.

prefixItems.title: all_enemies
prefixItems.description: List of enemy rows.

prefixItems.title: found
prefixItems.description: 1 if portal was found; 0 if not; null if unavailable.

prefixItems.title: portal_x
prefixItems.description: Portal's world X coordinate.

prefixItems.title: portal_y
prefixItems.description: Portal's world Y coordinate.

prefixItems.title: distance_to_portal
prefixItems.description: Distance from player to portal.

prefixItems.title: relative_x
prefixItems.description: Portal X minus player X; positive means right.

prefixItems.title: relative_y
prefixItems.description: Portal Y minus player Y.

entity.title: Entity context
entity.description: Event's entity object, including instance ID, name, type, and position when provided.

recent_actions.title: Recent action history
recent_actions.description: Previous action records, each [action, physics_frame, timestamp_unix_ms].

extra.title: Extra event payload
extra.description: Unmapped event-specific data and unknown fields preserved by the converter.
